_doc: PAINTED-BYTE ERA per layer — the short hash of the last product commit that changed THIS layer's painted bytes, and the renderer that produces them. The orchestrator's renderer identity is sha256(era, worker_type, model_role, defines, numerical environment, zoom) — the worker type is part of it because one group may declare a GPU and a CPU worker that were only ever parity-checked to 0.5 dB, and they must not share a task key, so bumping an era re-stales exactly that layer's tiles and a refactor that changes no byte re-stales nothing. Sibling SSOT of layer-spec.json: `renderers` must name the worker binary layer-spec selects for the layer's group (the GPU worker type when the group has one), which scripts/test-layer-spec.mjs checks, so a layer cannot move to another renderer without this file's era being edited in the same commit. BUMP a layer's era in the SAME commit as the engine change that alters its painted output; a missing layer fails closed. `zoom` overrides the base era for one tier only: bumping a z13 entry re-stales z13 and nothing at z12. The five surface layers carry 980eafdb, the commit at which relevant-source-surface's bytes became final, and their z13 entries hold the same era because one painter now produces both tiers.
